name: Jobify
description: Jobify is a self-hosted job application tracker. Track postings, statuses, interviews and follow-ups, import jobs from LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and other sites, search Indeed, LinkedIn and other boards with the optional Jobify JobSpy container, and optionally use an AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) to summarize postings and draft cover letters.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Where the Jobify database is stored.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: Port for the Jobify web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the data directory.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the data directory.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much to write to logs/jobify.log in the data folder: error, warn, log, or debug to record every request.

variables.name: AI provider
variables.description: Optional default AI provider: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama or openai_compatible. Can also be set in the app's Settings page.

variables.name: AI API key
variables.description: Optional API key for the default AI provider.

variables.name: AI model
variables.description: Optional model for the default AI provider.

variables.name: AI base URL
variables.description: Optional base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434 for Ollama.

variables.name: JobSpy URL
variables.description: Optional: the URL of a Jobify JobSpy container (install it from the Jobify JobSpy template), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000. Turns on the Find jobs page. Can also be set in the app's Settings page.

variables.name: JobSpy API key
variables.description: Optional: the API key set on the Jobify JobSpy container.
